notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level), gate runs used: 1. The card is a driver pack; this package covers one of its five entry symbols, the Thorlabs Kinesis motor controller (KinesisMotor), and NOT COVERED: the other four entry symbols, the AndorSDK2Camera, IDSPeakCamera, AlliedVisionVimbaXCamera and PicamCamera classes (each needs its vendor SDK and its essential output is an image array; they are named in facts.md). NOT COVERED inside the controller: only the default channel 1 is used (the channel count is read, no other channel is selected), and jog, move-by, the position reference, the limit-switch/trigger configuration, the piezo classes and the ADC inputs are not exposed. The stage travel range and velocity range are not stated in the clone, so max_velocity and the move target_position are Limit.operator_required: the driver refuses them (MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET) until the site supplies site-limits.json (site-limits.example.json is an example, not a statement about any stage). The fake is an in-memory object with placeholder values, not a recording of a device; the hardware backend (native.py, the FTDI connection) never ran, and being model-authored and unreviewed the package is not a hardware run. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
